[He was the son of Jīmūtaketu and renowned for his benevolent and charitable disposition. When his father's kingdom was invaded by his kinsmen, he scorned the idea of fighting with them and induced his father to leave it to those who sought for it and to repair with him to the Malaya mountain to lead a holy life. It is related that there he one day took the place of a young serpent who was, by virtue of an agreement, to be offered to Garuḍa as his daily meal, and induced, by his generous and touching behaviour, the enemy of serpents to give up his practice of devouring them. The story is very pathetically told in the play]. --वाहिन् smoke.

a: जीव — a. [जीव्-कर्तरि क] Living, existing. --वः 1 The principle of life, the vital breath, life, soul; गतजीव, जीवत्याग, जीवाशा, &c. --2 The individual or personal soul enshrined in the human body and imparting to it life, motion and sensation (called जीवात्मन् as opposed to परमात्मन् the Supreme soul); Y. 3. 131; Ms. 12. 22-23. --3 Life, existence. --4 A creature, living being. --5 Livelihood, profession. --6 N. of Karṇa. --7 N. of one of the Maruts. --8 The constellation पुष्य. --9 N. of Bṛhaspati. --10 The third lustrum in the cycle of Jupiter. --11 Association of cause and effect. --12 N. of Viṣṇu. --Comp. --अंतकः {1} a bird-catcher, fowler. {2} a murderer, slayer. --अजीबाधारः the world of organic and inorganic creation. --आत्मन् m. the individual soul enshrined in the human body (as opposed to परमात्मन् ‘the Supreme soul’). --आदानं abstracting healthy blood, bleeding, (in medic.). --आधानं preservation of life. --आधारः the heart. --इंधनं glowing fire-wood, burning wood. --उत्सर्गः ‘casting off life,’ voluntary death, suicide. --उपाधिः the three states, i. e. waking, dreaming and sleeping. --ऊर्णा the wool of a living animal. --गृहं, --मंदिरं ‘the abode of the soul,’ the body. --ग्राहः a prisoner taken alive. --घनः Brahmā. --ज a. born alive. --जीवः (also जीवंजीवः) the Cakora bird. --तोका a woman whose children are living. --दः {1} a physician. {2} an enemy. --दशा mortal existence. --धनं ‘living wealth’, property in the shape of living creatures, live-stock. --धानी the earth. --निकायः a being endowed with life. --पतिः f., --पत्नी a woman whose husband is alive. --पत्रं a fresh leaf. --पितृ, --पितृक a. (a son or daughter) whose father is still alive. --पुत्रा, --वत्सा a woman whose son is living. --मातृका the seven mothers or female divinities; (कुमारी धनदा नंदा विमला मंगला बला . पद्मा चेति च विख्याताः सप्तैता जीवमातृकाः). --योनिः a sentient being. --रक्तं menstrual blood. --लोकः {1} the world of living beings, the world of mortals, the world or worldly existence; त्वत्प्रयाणे शातांलोकः सर्वतो जीवलोकः Māl. 9. 37; जीवलोकतिलकः प्रलीयते 21; so स्वप्नेंद्रजालसदृशः खलु जीवलोकः Śānti. 2. 2; Bg. 11. 7; U. 4. 17. {2} living beings, mankind; दिवस इवाभ्रश्यामस्तपात्यये जीवलोकस्य Ś. 3. 12; or आलोकमर्कादिव जीवलोकः R. 5. 35. --वृत्तिः f. breeding or keeping cattle. --शेष a. one to whom only life is left, escaping only with life and nothing more. --शोणितं living, i. e., healthy blood. --संक्रमणं transmigration of the soul. --साधनं grain, corn. --साफल्यं relization or attainment of the chief end of human existence. --सूः ‘the mother of living beings’, a woman whose children are living. --स्थानं {1} a joint, an articulation. {2} the vital parts, heart.

v: pu॰ jIvan pitA yasya kap । vidyamAnapitfke jane । “amAsnAnaM gayASrAdDaM dakziRAmuKaBojanam । na jIvatpitfkaH kuryyAt kfte tu pitfhA Bavet” ti॰ ta॰ । tatra jIvatpitfkasya SrAdDaviSeze'DikAraH nirRayasinDO vyavasTApito yaTA । “jIvatpitfkasya sAgnereva vfdDiSrAdDe'DikAraH na tu niragneH “na jIvatpivfkaH kuryyAcCrAdDamagnimfte dvijaH । yeBya eva pitA dadyAtteByaH kurvIta sAgnikaH । pitAmahe'pyevameva kuryyAjjIvati sAgnikaH । sAgniko'pi na kurvvIta jIvati prapitAmahe” iti candrikAyAM sumantUkterityAhuH prayogapArijAte'pyanAhitAgnirna kuryyAditIdaM vyAKyAtam tanna “anagniko'pi kurvIta janmAdO vfdDikarmaRi । yeBya eva pitA dadyAttAnevoddiSya tarpayediti” hArItokteH sOmantavantu vfdDiSrAdDaBinnaSrAdDaparamityuktaM madanaratne । SrAdDapadaM piRqapitfyajYaparamiti pfTvIcandrodayaH । nirRayAmfte tu hArItIye'nagnikonAhitAgniraBipretaH pUrvavacane tu sAgniH SrOtAgniH smArttAgniScocyate । tenoBayAgnihInasya netyuktaM tanna pUrvoktadiSA gatisamBavenAgnipadasya smArttAgniparatve mAnABAvAt vakzyamARanityAnityasaMyogaviroDAt “pitaro janakasyejyA yAvadvratapanAhitam । samAhitavrataH paScAt svAn yajeta pitAmahAniti, pfTvIcandrodaye yamavaco viroDAcca । aparArke'pi samAvarttane vrahmacArI svayameva nAndISrAdDaM kuryyAdityAhuH ataH pUrvameva sADu vopadevo'pyevamAha । yattu mataM jIvatpitfkasya putranAmakarmmAdO na vfdDiSrAdDam hArItIye janmAdAvityAdiSabdena tatprAptAvapi “udvAhe putrajanane putryezwyAM sOmike maKe । tIrTe brAhmaRa AyAte zeqete jIvataH pituriti” mEtrapariSizwe udvAha eva tasyopasaMhArAt evaM yatra tu saMskArAdipadaM tadapyudvAhAdiparameveti tanna udvAhapadasya svavivAhaparatvasyApi samBavAt putravivAhaparatve mAnABAvAt “nAmakarmaRi bAlAnAM cUqAkarmmAdike taTA” ityAdiBirnityaSrAdDasya cOlAdyaNgatvAvagatO nityAnityasaMyogaviroDAcca ato janmAdAviti sarvasaMskArasaMgrahaH । taTA ca kAtyAyanaH “svapitfByaH pitA dadyAt sutasaMskArakarBasu । piRqAnodvAhanAttezAM tasTABAve tu tatkramAt” । sutAnAM cOlAdisaMskArezu pitA svapitfByaH piRqAn SrAdDam । “piRqado'SaharaScEzAmiti” rdaSanAt OdvahanAdvivAhaparyyantaM dadyAt vivAhaSca praTamaH “nAndISrAdDaM pitA kuryyAdAdye pARigrahe buDaH । ata UrdDvaM prakurvvIta svayameva tu nAndikamiti” smfteH tasya pituraBAve tatkramAt “asaMskftAstu saMskAryyA BrAzfBiH pUrvasaMskftEriti” yaH kartfkramaH tena krameRa jyezWaBrAtrAdirdadyAditi candrikAdayaH । hemAdristu tasya pituraBAve yaH pitfvya mAtulAdiH saMskuryyAt sa tatkramAt saMskAryyapitfkramAddadyAnnatu svapitfBya iti vyAcaKyO । samAvartanasyApi vivAhaprAcInasutasaMskAratvAtpitEva nAndISrAdDaM kuryyAt tadaBAve jyezWaBrAtrAdiH tadaBAve svayameva kuryyAt । upanayanena karmmADikArasya jAtatvAt evamAdyavivAhe'pIti pfTvIcandrodayanvandrikAdayaH । madanaratne'pyevam । yadA tu pitari saMnyaste prozite patite vA DarmmArTaM tatputramanyaH saMskuryyAttadA saMskAryyapituH pitrAdiByo dadyAt “pitaro janakasyejyA yAvadvratamanAhitam । samAhitavrataH paScAtsvAn yajeta pitAmahAniti” pfTvAcandrodaye yamokteH jIvatpitfkasya viSezamAha kAtyAyanaH “vfdDO tIrTe ca saMnyaste tAte ca patite sati । yeBya eva pitA dadyAtteByo dadyAtsvayaM sutaH” iti । tIrTa iva prAyaScitANgaSrAdDe'pi tasyADikAraH । “pitari jIvati yaH SrAdDaM kuryyAt sa yezAM pitAkuryyAttezAM kuryyAt । pitari pitAmahe ca jIvani yezAM pitAmahaH kuryyAt tezAM kuryyAt trizu jIvatsu nEva kuryyAt” vizRu॰ sa॰ “jIvatpitfko'pi” kAtyA॰ SrO॰ sU॰ piRqapitfyajYe'Gikriyate ca । “jIvAntarhite'pi” karkasU॰ “jovapitfkasya jIvena pitrAdinA antarhite'pi vyavahite'pi pitAmahAdeH piRqadAnaM Bavati somAdAviva “yeBya eva pitA dadyAtteByo dadyAttaTA sutaH” iti karkasmfteH । “jIvapitfkasya homAntamanAramBo vA” sU॰ । “jovapitfkasya yajamAnasya homAntameva piRqapitfyajYasaMjYaM karma Bavati aTavA'nAramBa eva piRqapitfyajYasya vASabdaH pUrvapakzanirAsArTaH । atrAnAramBapakza eva yuktaH yataH piRqadAnaM praDAnam । tadaBAve homasyANgaBUtasyAnuzWAnaM na Gawate । evaM jIvAntarhite'pIti pakzaM dUpayitvA jIvatpitfkasya homAntamityatropapattimAha” karkaH । “na vyavete jAtUkarRyo na jIvantamati dadAtIti” sU॰ । “jIvapitfkasya homAntakarmma kurvataH yatojAtUkarRya AcAryyo na vyavete jIvatA pitrA vyavahite pitAmahAdO piRqadAnaM na BavatotyAha kuto na BavatItyatra hetuH “na jIvantamati dadAtIti” SAKAntare SravaRAt ataHpraDAne piRqadAne jIvatpitfkasya nizidDe anAramBa eva Gawate na homAntatA । ApastambaH “yadi jIvatpitA na dadyAdA homAt kftvA viramediti” mAnave ca “yadi dadyAdyeBya eva pitA dadyAtteByo dadyAditi” kAWake “pitAputrO cedAhitAgnI syAtAM yeByaH pitA teByaH putro dadyAt pitA pretaH syAt pitAmaho jIvet pitre piRqaM niDAya pitAmahAtparAByAM dvAByAM daDyAditi” karka॰ jIvaputro'pyatra । samAsAntaviDeranityatvAt na kap । jIvapitf ityapi tatrArTe ।
